body: Improving reasoning abilities in Large Language Models (LLMs) requires high-quality data that exposes difficult decisions, competing alternatives, and their consequences. Data scarcity is driven by the low quality of synthetic data and the cost of human labeling. We introduce Self-Play Search Distillation (SPSD), a framework for generating superhuman synthetic data via self-play of MuZero-like networks trained on board games. SPSD uses executable environments to turn search into structured reasoning problems. At each state, the expert identifies a preferred decision, plausible alternatives, plausible opponent replies, and value estimates. By converting the self-play search records into superhuman chains-of-thought, we train LLMs with environment-grounded supervision. Although trained only on self-play search records, SPSD transfers to unseen mathematics. On Qwen3-4B-Base, it raises the mean over six mathematics benchmarks from 24.1 to 36.6 while increasing the held-out-game win rate from 15% to 45%. SPSD offers an annotation-efficient way to create high-quality synthetic data for improving LLM performance in reasoning tasks.
summaryZh: 本文提出了自博弈搜索蒸馏（SPSD）框架，旨在通过MuZero风格的网络自博弈生成高质量合成数据，以提升大模型的推理能力。SPSD利用可执行环境将搜索过程转化为结构化的推理问题，通过记录专家决策、替代方案及价值估计，生成超人类水平的思维链数据。实验表明，仅使用自博弈数据训练的Qwen3-4B模型在数学基准测试中表现显著提升。该方法有效缓解了高质量推理数据稀缺的问题，为大模型推理能力的提升提供了高效的训练策略。
